morwen_intro.speaker: morwen
morwen_intro.text: Close the stack door, Elorin. If the Ilmyra inquisitors see this folio, they won't just burn the parchment—they will unbind my academic credentials. I have found the lost mathematical proofs of Archmage Varis.

start_quest.title: The Heretic's Thesis
start_quest.desc: Recover and evaluate a banned theoretical treatise on void resonance hidden in House Ilmyra.
stages: Confront Scholar Morwen in the Ilmyra restricted stacks
Choose whether to preserve or suppress the manuscript

choices.text: [Acumen Check] Varis proved that the void is not empty space—it is an unvibrated medium with its own harmonic tension.
Why was Varis cast out by the Conclave eight centuries ago?
This research is dangerously close to what we are attempting with the Nullstone.

morwen_explain.speaker: morwen
morwen_explain.text: Because he argued that the Elder Song could be silenced! The Solari called it blasphemy. But looking at the Northreach reports, he wasn't predicting catastrophe—he was warning us!

choices.text: Let me examine the equations for void containment.

morwen_debate.speaker: morwen
morwen_debate.text: Exactly! If your containment team works from flawed assumptions about void behavior, your prototype will fail under load.

choices.text: Then we must preserve these folios in secret.

morwen_acumen_pass.speaker: morwen
morwen_acumen_pass.text: You understand! Look at theorem seven—the decay rate resolves as a logarithmic spiral rather than a linear drop. This changes everything.

choices.text: Integrate Varis's spiral decay theorem into the Nullstone calculations.

morwen_acumen_fail.speaker: morwen
morwen_acumen_fail.text: The cipher is dense, but the core geometry is clear. We cannot allow House Ilmyra to erase this knowledge.

choices.text: Smuggle the copy to the Academy Theory Wings.

morwen_resolve.speaker: morwen
morwen_resolve.text: The manuscript is transcribed and safe. Whatever happens to me, the truth of the void's geometry survives in your hands, Elorin.
